bracketGoal: 3 Game Changers: Opposition Agent, Mystical Tutor, Aura Shards · all-odd deck, Obosh companion · Today version has 1 (Opposition Agent)
name: Thanos & Obosh
notes: Companion: Obosh, the Preypiercer (outside the 100). Every nonland card must have an odd mana value or Obosh is illegal. No even-cost cards, ever (Coalition Victory was ruled out for this; he chose Obosh).

Plan: cast Thanos ({R}{W}{B}), then power-up for {C}{W}{U}{B}{R}{G} (only {C}{U}{G} the turn he enters). Always choose EVEN: his creatures are all odd, so the wipe is one-sided. Obosh doubles damage from odd sources: Thanos, Jeska, Mayhem Devil, Maximum Carnage (chapter III = 10 to each opponent); Absorbing Man and Titania doubles it again.

The {C} is true colorless, and it's the bottleneck. Colorless sources: all 10 pain lands, Fetid Heath, Twilight Mire, Sol Ring, Castle Doom, Rogue's Passage, Grand Coliseum, Unclaimed Territory, Plaza of Heroes, Villainous Hideout, Secluded Courtyard (name Villain).
Plaza of Heroes and Villainous Hideout can pay any symbol of the power-up once Thanos is out.
Repeat wipes: Ephemerate, Conjurer's Closet or Venser's +2 blinks Thanos, so he 'entered this turn' and the power-up costs just {C}{U}{G} again.
Tokens are mana value 0 (even), so his own tokens die to the wipe too. Skullclamp a token before the wipe for cards. Kindred Dominance naming Villain keeps Thanos and nearly all his creatures.
Game Changers (3): Opposition Agent, Mystical Tutor, Aura Shards. Mystic Remora: draw off it 2–3 turns, then let it go.

Changes since Oct 17 rebuild: Champion's Helm → Ephemerate; Forest, Island → Secluded Courtyard, Unknown Shores; Rhystic Study → Mystic Remora; Teferi's Protection → Mystical Tutor; Painful Truths → Narset → Aura Shards.

Odd-cost upgrade ideas if a villain is a dud: Esper Sentinel, Skullclamp, Vindicate, Generous Gift, Swan Song, Gilded Lotus, Palladium Myr. Avoid Ancient Tomb/Mana Vault (Game Changers) and Mind Stone/Thran Dynamo (even).
Not all Marvel card mana values were confirmed. Moxfield will flag an illegal Obosh on import if one is even.

Nov 24, 2026: 'Today' version = what can be sleeved now from his pile plus cards already in the house (see 'Owned — pull' in Adds). Each 'Buy' in Adds is a one-for-one swap from Today; finishing them gives this main list.

Nov 24, 2026: merged rebuild from his pile + the old vault list (old list kept as the 'Old B3' version). Added from his pile: Maximum Carnage, Kindred Dominance, Skullclamp, Reanimate, Iron Monger, Archnemesis, Typhoid Mary, Swift Demise, Visions of Villainy. Splinter's Technique is mana value 4 and can't be played with Obosh.

Nov 24, 2026 (later): land base rebuilt from cards in the house — 10 pain lands (each also taps for {C}, which fixes the power-up's colorless bottleneck), shock lands, five multiplayer duals (Luxury Suite, Spectator Seating, Spire Garden, Undergrowth Stadium, Morphic Pool), Isolated Chapel, villain/colorless utility lands, 7 basics for Cultivate/Fabled Passage. Multiversal Passage went to Doom Unrivaled.

Nov 24, 2026 (later): new upgrades — Absorbing Man and Titania (doubles damage; with Obosh, odd sources deal 4x), Stilt-Man (steals noncreature permanents on Villain combat damage), The Spot, Living Portal (exile on a Villain body). Out: Deflecting Swat (not buying it), Worn Powerstone (pain lands make {C}), Mister Sinister (bench), Superior Foes. Venomized Cat stays (his call).

Buy list is 17 cards, about $125 (Flawless Maneuver, Overgrown Tomb and Morphic Pool added; Terra keeps her Path, Swords and Flawless). Absorbing Man and Titania is the top want. Optional extras: Cloudshift, The Coming of Galactus, Cosmic Cube.

Nov 24, 2026 (later): Urborg cut (too expensive); Godless Shrine back in its slot. Fetid Heath replaced the first Godless Shrine slot. Overgrown Tomb and Morphic Pool aren't in the house: buys, with Vernal Fen and Sunken Hollow holding their slots in Today.
Nov 24, 2026 (later): Twilight Mire in for Godless Shrine — green was the thinnest color (~13 sources) and the turn-1-2 dorks need it.
Nov 24, 2026 (later): Bedevil in for Chaos Warp. Terminate is mana value 2, so it can't go in with Obosh.

Nov 24, 2026 (later): Irma and Shredder in for Mole Man and Typhoid Mary (Visions of Villainy stays, his call). Irma copying Obosh (once Obosh is cast from the companion zone) makes a second Obosh: odd sources deal 4x damage, 8x with Absorbing Man and Titania. Shredder attacks every opponent at once and each one he hits loses half their life. Neither is a Villain, so Kindred Dominance naming Villain kills them.
Nov 24, 2026 (later): added a B2 version (no Game Changers): Opposition Agent → Sandman, Mystical Tutor → Read the Bones, Aura Shards → Withering Torment.
